setup.bobHint: Choose one bob for this experiment.
setup.lengthHint: Drag the marker on the ruler or type a length from 0.100 to 1.000 m.
setup.releaseHint: Drag the needle on the protractor or type an angle.
setup.thresholdHint: A swing is counted when the bob returns outward to this angle on the release side.

running.title: Experiment running
running.runningHint: The stopwatch and counter advance automatically.

paused.title: Experiment paused
paused.frozenHint: Physics and stopwatch are frozen. Resume when you are ready.

confirm.title: Confirm readings
confirm.subtitle: Check each value, then save your trials.
confirm.editHint: Values clamp to their instrument range when you leave the field.

dialogs.bobHint: Pick the bob by mass, then select to continue.
dialogs.lengthHint: Drag the ruler segment or use ± to change the length by 1 mm.
dialogs.releaseHint: Drag the highlighted bob or the protractor needle, from 5° to 90°.
dialogs.thresholdHint: Drag the circle handle on the release side, from 1° to 89°.
dialogs.completeHint: Finish the guided setup, then press Start.
